notes.title: An epic collaboration between the Ruses and Witch's Potion!
notes.notes:
[p]The world Rena has stumbled into is anything but ordinary. And it's not just the presence of magic, demons, strange races, or steampunk technology. This realm is open to visitors from all planes and realities - every now and then, truly astonishing figures find their way in. Of course, not just anyone can manage to arrive here. And getting out won't be easy either, though some might not want to leave at all.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXefIcnKXmOY0GiDrdf33KsyUBXEK3Zlp17ppRLR22F4ZNXkcmsvtP4keqKstqg9pODDOprZJwfskoWzIMA1-PdtKmIR8e5S61yg2QwtKSEgGXM-YA-rVBEokVxbMM0T7jZDG69IqA?key=djrlQIw_WgcpwzBPwHoiLA"][/img][/p][p]As fate would have it, our witch is destined to cross paths with a heroine from the distant northern lands. Miloslava's power, as everyone knows, is surpassed only by her beauty, wisdom, and kindness - and even then, only barely…[/p][p]Together, they’ll uncover a secret plot hatched by cunning lizards who escaped Hyperborea and settled in the foul swamps near the city.[/p][p]These lizards are worse than cockroaches - they can slither into any world. Turn your back for a moment, and they're already desecrating sacred lands, kidnapping maidens, and committing unspeakable lewdness. Worst of all? They’re doing it without you! What self-respecting witch would let that stand?[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfPSKSfyJ_JWkdxy1bhRtCeXQjyIFGBkdheU4OQv3UO2kwps0zgMqV3HW8a10XboBy-hfiX4sFRYVe03E3D7KIerHvmDWzTgTATwl5Yvs2N0mO9H9LC7ORrxQF3Ge8o4dhkjvNh?key=djrlQIw_WgcpwzBPwHoiLA"][/img][/p][p]And as for how to deal with the scaly menace - that's for you to decide. You'll need the light powers, a witch's cunning, and a few tricks best seen for yourself rather than read in any chronicle.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957880/Witch_Potions__Craft_of_Lust/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

It’s been a while since our last update - hope you’ll forgive us! We’ve been working hard, juggling art, code, and voiceovers to bring you something awesome.

The second part is coming along nicely - expect stunning ladies, fiery (though not warm-blooded) lizardfolk, and... a certain someone we’re keeping a secret for now 😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/ce8dce116311c6dc9f4bfc3c7898605dead6ee54.png[/img]

And in a surprising twist, one of the key players in the upcoming story is… you’ll never guess… Dolboslav! Bet you didn’t see that coming! Think he can handle it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/9d25fb198931627f1fdb146aa09d9898b8ee9183.png[/img]

While we’re busy with part two, we’ve got something to tide you over - next month, we’re releasing voiceovers for the first game! We’ve shown you some of it already, but there’s even more waiting in the game.
It’s gonna be fire!

Stay tuned! ❤️

notes.title: Humans are not that against Lizardwomen 2
notes.notes:
Greetings, humans! 

Didn’t expect this, huh? 

We didn’t either! But you loved our lizards so much that we couldn’t let this one go. The lizards’ rule prevailed, and we had to come up with Part 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/488e70eb7cbd5cfef03b4131e092dc6800383424.png[/img]

So, what’s in store for us?

Once sworn enemies, Slavs and Lizards made peace for the glory of the Holy Stand! Two species coexist in harmony, enjoying life of passion and lust with each other. Exactly as father Perun willed it... Although it is only true for a single village. For now.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/ac268eb5ef65aeb32f220d569ab5768488de6a75.png[/img]

Ratibor, the champion of Slavs, and the warrior lizard Viente travel to the Lizardwomen capital, Atlantis, to seal an official friendship agreement between the peoples and spread peace and love into every corner of both Hyperborea and Atlantis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/85146e88697c09201bccb4a3506f8eae2937ba0c.png[/img]

But can the century-long grudge between Lizards and Slavs truly be cast aside? Or is it just a calm before the storm? Might Mathematics, the goddess of lizards, be planning something? Or maybe there is some third party seeking to shatter the fragile peace?

In short, there will be lizards, and heroes, and beautiful ladies, and they’ll face many challenges together - whenever they can ignore their carnal instincts, of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/e8abc72266d01adece00b4aba58d42952bb6568b.png[/img]

The first part of Humans are not that against Lizardwomen will receive updates as well - we haven’t forgotten about them! Remember Lurkomorye? We do too! It’s coming - very soon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/c833346c179d5fc87f13bd9bad0d75abba12af92.png[/img]

Stay tuned! 

And don’t forget to Add the game to Wishlisht - you don’t want to miss it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840
